description: What sacrificing part of a salary into a pension does: take-home, Child Benefit charge, what lands in the pension, and the sacrifice that would bring income exactly under £100,000, under the Child Benefit charge, or out of higher-rate tax. Use for 'what would sacrificing £5k save me'.

children.description: Children Child Benefit is claimed for. Defaults to 0.

employerNiSharePct.description: Share of the employer's National Insurance saving passed into the pension, 0 to 100. Defaults to 0.

grossSalary.description: Gross salary, in pounds a year.

sacrifice.description: Amount sacrificed into the pension, in pounds a year.

scotland.description: Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

name: calculate_salary_sacrifice
title: Salary sacrifice into a pension
